chars.STEPMOM: a Moroccan woman in her early 40s wearing a mustard-yellow embroidered house kaftan and a dark green headscarf, gold bangles
chars.NARRATOR: a thin Moroccan young man of 18 with short curly black hair, wearing a faded red hoodie and grey jeans
chars.AUNT: a plump Moroccan woman in her 50s wearing a navy blue djellaba and a white headscarf, reading glasses

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan family living room in Casablanca, seen from the doorway where the witness stands: STEPMOM, head-to-waist, face clearly visible, leans over a low table and sweetly slides a stack of official papers and a glass of mint tea toward NARRATOR with an unusually warm, too-friendly smile; NARRATOR sits on the sofa, wary. Warm afternoon light, 2D flat illustration, centred subjects, calm edges, no text

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room: STEPMOM nods agreeably and signs a document at the table without any argument, while AUNT and NARRATOR exchange surprised glances across the table covered with folders and ID cards. 2D flat illustration, centred subjects, faces visible, no text

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of NARRATOR in a dim hallway of the Moroccan house, frowning suspiciously over his shoulder toward the kitchen where a soft silhouette of a woman in a yellow kaftan moves, he holds a folder of papers. Moody evening light, 2D flat illustration, face visible, no text

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan kitchen doorway: STEPMOM stands with eyes lowered, hand on her chest, looking ashamed and apologetic, softly asking NARRATOR for forgiveness; NARRATOR stands stiffly in the doorway, arms crossed, unsure. 2D flat illustration, head-to-waist, faces visible, centred, no text

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan notary office (adoul) with wooden desk, stamps and files: STEPMOM and NARRATOR sit side by side facing the desk, an old notary in a white djellaba and cap points at a document between them; STEPMOM glances sideways at NARRATOR with a calculating look. 2D flat illustration, centred subjects, faces visible, no text
